author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Cemu 2.6: official stable release
summary: Cemu published 2.6 on February 6, 2025. The release record documents an official stable release for the Wii U emulator project.
searchKeywords: Wii U emulator release update changelog

blocks.text: The Cemu project published version 2.6 on February 6, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: Exporting saves via the title manager no longer crashes when the export path contains unicode characters. Fixed a regression in DS Virtual Console titles ( 1440). Fixed a bug where the debug shader dumping option would try to write files to the wrong directory. Added a right-click context menu to the PPC debugger disassembly view and fixed some smaller bugs in the debugger.
